description: Ranks Halloween costume ideas from a fixed catalog of 169 against the supplied audience, interests, vibe, effort level, and owned materials, and returns the top 3 matches. Each pick includes a why-line explaining the match, a thumbnail image, a link to its full build page, and the estimated time and effort. Owned items boost ranking: ideas whose materials are covered by the supplied owned items rank higher. Interest is the strongest ranking signal: ideas matching the stated interest outrank others.

group_size.description: Optional: how many people need costumes (for family/group picks).

interest.description: Optional but powerful: what the wearer is into, e.g. 'dinosaurs', 'animals', 'princesses', 'superheroes', 'video games', 'tv characters', 'food', 'sports'. This is the strongest ranking signal: ideas matching the interest win.

owned_items.description: Optional: things the user already owns, e.g. ['bedsheet'], ['cardboard', 'tape']. Ideas buildable from owned items rank higher.

who_for.description: Who the costume is for: e.g. 'toddler', '3-year-old', 'kid', 'adult', 'couple', 'family', 'group of 5'.

name: pick_costume
title: Pick a costume
